about: runtime.db: the runtime's only database, and only what the runtime itself needs (the owner 2026-09-28: data stays in wid): no record value, no delivery; a member or an account only as its platform key, on a run record (the caller). Tables are created from here and nowhere else; a table that differs is refused, never kept.

runtime_locker.about: an agent the runtime holds: its folder and the sha256 of its code and manifest, checked on every call and run

runtime_runs.about: every call and job run, refused ones too, by the agent's key and the job's: its state, its times, what was charged, a plain reason (never an agent's words); every count the runtime shows is counted here; the caller's account and member keys as the platform gave them (the five-device proof: a run names its caller), never a name or a value
